steps.description: CLO routes Fsys/64 (24MHz/64) to P1.3 (pin 11): true 375kHz via Bresenham phase accumulation. Long-run window: the headless engine batches firmware execution in ~10ms master ticks (all edges in a tick share one timestamp), so sub-10ms windows read empty; the multi-second average dilutes batch quantization below 0.2% and resolves the silicon-exact rate (verified stable within +-500Hz across runs). Exact step-level proof lives in host CTest test_mcs51_cms8s_clo.
